full_text:
Jeff Washburn is an American singer who performed the vocals in the English version of the Huntik: Secrets & Seekers theme song, '"Huntik Go". 

== Biography ==
Washburn is also a professional guitarist and has a dance band called "The Eleven" and an a cappella band called "Blue Jupiter".

{{Infobox cast|image=Jeff Washburn.jpg|job=Singer of ''[[Huntik Go]]''|dub=English}}'''Jeff Washburn''' is an American singer who performed the vocals in the English version of the ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]'' theme song, '"[[Huntik Go]]". 

== Biography ==
Washburn is also a professional guitarist and has a dance band called "The Eleven" and an a cappella band called "Blue Jupiter".
